title: ranunculus parviflorus subsp. chius
intro: Ranunculus parviflorus subsp. chius, commonly known as Small-flowered Butterscotch, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus parviflorus subsp. chius include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which may help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
